text: vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti . atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmāti . [174] atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu . ekamantaṃ
